newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Amoco in talks with Israel Oil Refineries.
newsitem.headline: Amoco in talks with Israel Oil Refineries.

text.p: A delegation of senior Amoco Corp executives is holding talks in Israel with officials of state-owned Oil Refineries Ltd, a spokeswoman for Oil Refineries said on Monday.
"The discussions are focusing on future cooperation in the fields of refining and marketing," she said.
The delegation is headed by Douglas Ford, an Amoco executive vice-president.

The spokeswoman said Oil Refineries, which has a domestic monopoly of petroleum refining, has been holding talks with other major international oil companies. Press reports have identified them as Mobil Corp and Exxon Corp, but the spokeswoman refused to confirm any names.
Oil Refineries, with facilities in Haifa and Ashdod, is 74 percent owned by the government of Israel and 26 percent owned by Israel Corp.
The company, whose operating licence expires in the year 2003, has been discussed as a candidate for privatisation.
